title: Spark Structured Streaming job that reads from kafka isn't shown in kafka consumer groups
question:
I have created a spark streaming job using pyspark that uses readStream to read from a kafka topic and then uses writeStream to write into a table in Oracle database. The job can successfully read data and write to oracle table in real-time, I have tried producing messages while running the spark streaming job and it was able to read and write to oracle table immediately. The problem is that i couldn't find the consumer group for my spark job that consumed from the kafka topic. I looked for it using this command:

/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server myserver --list

but nothing is there

here is the code for the spark job:

topic = ""
schema_registry_url = ""

streaming_df = spark \
        .readStream \
        .format("kafka") \
        .option("kafka.bootstrap.servers", "")\
        .option("subscribe", topic) \
        .option("startingOffsets", "earliest") \
        .option("partition", "0") \
        .option("groupIdPrefix", "IamTheConsumer")\
        .load()

parsed_df=streaming_df.selectExpr("CAST(key AS STRING)", "CAST(value AS STRING)")

parsed_df.writeStream \
    .outputMode("append")\
    .foreachBatch(SaveToOracle)\ ##there is a function for this that does its job correctly
    .start() \
    .awaitTermination()

I was expecting to find my spark consumer in kafka UI or via /opt/kafka/bin/kafka-consumer-groups.sh but I didn't find anything about it. *Taking into consideration that it wrote the data in the destination table so the job consumed data.
answer:
Reason may be spark streaming job is configured with enable.auto.commit = false,check it once again.

If enable.auto.commit configuration property is false then even though you read messages still you cannot see your consumer in below list.

/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server myserver --list

If enable.auto.commit = true then kafka will periodically receive the committed offsets from spark streaming job.
